title: Updating Outside a Written Interval
statement: Let $\mu,f:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{Z}$, and let $d,j,y\in\mathbb{N}$ and $w\in\mathbb{Z}$. Suppose that $y<d$ or $d+j\le y$. Updating at $y$ the sequence obtained by writing the first $j$ values of $f$ into $\mu$ starting at $d$ gives the same sequence as first updating $\mu$ at $y$ to $w$ and then making that write.
hypotheses_covered: y is outside the interval: y < d or d + j ≤ y
The update value w is an integer
replaced:
Let $\mu$ be an integer-valued memory function, let $dst,j$ be natural numbers, and let
$f:\mathbb N\to\mathbb Z$. If $y$ lies outside the interval of indices from $dst$
through $dst+j-1$, then updating the memory obtained by writing the first $j$ values of
$f$ starting at $dst$ at index $y$ to value $w$ is the same as first updating $\mu$ at
$y$ to $w$ and then performing that write.
